purpose: Teach: 不本意/産出/公国/喘息/仰天/変異/転覆/大麻

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、不本意な治療を強いる事案を医療チームで避けるよう徹底します
lines.en: Ren, we make sure the medical team avoids imposing unwanted treatment on patients.
lines.style: Clear and measured. Opens with Ren's name as a gentle anchor. Steady pace, professional but human. The tone of someone explaining protocol that matters to her personally.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医薬品産出地域の安全管理を医療チームで確認します
lines.en: Yes—we confirm medication supply chain safety across the medical team.
lines.style: Brief nod of acknowledgment. Slightly faster rhythm, methodical. No hesitation—this is established procedure. Warm but matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 海外公国からの医療研修生を、貴院、ご受け入れですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital does accept medical trainees from abroad, don't you, sensei?
lines.style: Gentle inquiry, building understanding rather than challenging. Respectful distance maintained—formal honorific sits naturally. Soft curiosity, almost tentative.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、小児喘息の長期治療を医療チームで担当しております
lines.en: Yes—we handle long-term pediatric asthma care as a team across our department.
lines.style: Calm recitation of fact. Slight emphasis on 'long-term' to show the commitment it requires. Steady breath. Professional warmth underneath the protocol.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 珍しい症例に医師団が仰天した経験を、貴院、お持ちですね、先生
lines.en: Has your hospital had experience with rare cases that surprised the medical staff, sensei?
lines.style: Careful phrasing, genuine interest underneath. Searching gently for deeper knowledge. Respects the honorific. Pace deliberate—he's thinking through the question as he asks.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、ウイルスの変異株の動向を医療チームで監視します
lines.en: Yes—we monitor emerging viral variants across the medical team.
lines.style: Steady, professional delivery. Slight weight on 'monitor'—suggests vigilance. No alarm, just competent attention. Breath even throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療現場の体制転覆を、貴院、なさったそうですね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital has restructured its medical systems, hasn't it, sensei?
lines.style: Reflective pause before speaking. Thoughtful tone, not accusatory. The question carries respect for the significance of change. Measured cadence, almost philosophical.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、大麻の医療応用研究を医療チームで参照しております
lines.en: Yes—we're currently reviewing research on medical applications of cannabis as a team.
lines.style: Composed but slightly more open than before. A hint of thoughtfulness on 'currently reviewing'—acknowledging this is evolving work. Breath natural, word choice careful.
